verdict.rationale: Omarchy documents built-in hotkey notices that show the date, time and current weather, plus a built-in countdown reminder timer. That covers the clock and weather parts of the story in a lightweight form. No calendar or maps app is documented as shipping out of the box. Missing for 10: a built-in calendar app, a built-in maps app, full standalone clock and weather apps, and independent hands-on corroboration.

support.subject: As a switcher, I can rely on built-in utilities like calendar, weather, maps, and clock apps out of the box

citations.quote: You can quickly access the date and time, battery status, and current weather using the hotkey notices.
Omarchy has a built-in way to set simple reminders based on a countdown timer and with a message.
